You have **3 things due** before Sunday:

1. **ACG 2021, Guided Practice 6** (Wed, 11:59 PM). About 1.5 h, worth 20 pts.
2. **MAN 3025, Connect Quiz 4** (Thu). About 1 h.

about.intro: EagleDocs is an academic assistant for university students. It reads your Canvas courses and your Degree Works audit and turns them into plans, study aids and straight answers.
about.modelsBody1: EagleDocs includes its own model, an open-weight model from the DeepSeek family running on our servers. It is free for students, with a daily limit. As better open models come out, we update it.
about.modelsBody2: Behind it all is PixlAI-Engine, our agent engine: it plans, uses tools like Canvas and your workspace, and keeps working on our servers. You can also connect your ChatGPT account through Codex, or use your own Claude, DeepSeek or OpenAI API key. In Auto mode, EagleDocs sends quick questions to a fast model and harder ones to a stronger model.
about.workspaceBody: Every student gets a private workspace: a small, isolated computer on our servers. EagleDocs uses it to read PDFs and Word files, run code for your assignments and keep the files it creates for you.
about.specCpuNote: Workspaces share CPU time on the same servers, up to half a core each.
about.specMemNote: Enough for documents, spreadsheets and small programs.
about.specDiskNote: Room for course files, drafts and projects. Your files stay between sessions.
about.specIdleNote: Of inactivity. It wakes up the next time you ask for something.
about.sharedBody: Giving every student dedicated cores would need a huge server farm. Workspaces take turns instead, which keeps EagleDocs free. During busy moments a heavy task may wait a few seconds in line.
about.isolationBody: Each workspace is isolated from the others and from the rest of the server. Other students cannot see your files, and you can delete them from Files at any time.
about.hardware: EagleDocs runs on our own Intel Xeon servers. Plans with more resources may come later.
home.poweredBy: EagleDocs runs on its own Intel Xeon servers.
about.backgroundTitle: Keeps working when you close the page
about.backgroundBody: Everything runs on our servers, not in your browser. Start a long task, close the tab or lock your phone, and EagleDocs finishes it. You get a notification when it is done.
